sentences.text: 1 This application under Section 430 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023, has been filed seeking suspension of sentence of the applicants/accused no.1 and 2 in S.C.No.20 of 2019 on the file of the Court of Session, Kasaragod.
They have been found guilty of the offences punishable under Section 323, 324, 326, and 307 read with Section 34 IPC.
They have been sentenced to varying terms of imprisonment for the aforesaid offences.
The sentences have been directed to run concurrently.
The maximum period of imprisonment they will have to undergo is five years.
2. The application is opposed by the learned public prosecutor, who submits that the applicant/first accused has criminal antecedents.
She has handed over a report of the SHO concerned which refers to the criminal antecedents of applicant/A1 thus - in 1.
Badiadka Police Station Crime No.199/19 U/s 153 IPC.
2. Kasaragod Police Station Crime No.27/20 U/s 143, 147, 506 read with Section 149 IPC.

3. Badiadka Police Station Crime No.41/20 U/s 354(A)(1), 363, 376(II)(i) IPC and Section 4 r/w 3(a)
(b), 10 r/w 9(l) of PoCSO Act.
4.
Badiadka Police Station Crime No.539/18 U/s 143, 147, 148, 153, 323, 324, 3087 read with 149 IPC.
However, it is reported that the second applicant/second accused has no criminal antecedents.
That being the position, the first applicant/first accused is not entitled to a suspension of the sentence.
